dvids.title: John Finn Conducts A Visit, Board, Search, and Seizure Drill
dvids.desc: U.S. Sailors conduct a visit, board, search, and seizure drill aboard Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS John Finn (DDG 113), Oct. 28, 2026. John Finn is deployed to the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations to support maritime security and stability in the Middle East. (U.S. Navy video)
